scope: Non-exhaustive proposed categorical pair inventory; disease labels and source leads are provisional. No patient-level observations or validated clinical assertions.
counting_rule: One ordered pair per candidate; contexts and transcript/exon variants are not separate fusions. Regulatory events counted separately.
source_policy: Discovery leads identify where to begin review; they do not certify that a source directly supports every listed pair, context, mechanism, or oncogenicity claim.
